flat:
Goal: Instagram carousel, first slide.
Scene: Photograph set in Basement gym at 6am, condensation on the windows.
Subject: A retired boxer taping his hands in a basement gym.
Style: Medium close-up, 85mm portrait, f/2.8. Softbox key camera-left. Kodak Portra 400, desaturated earth tones grade, palette: #0B3D2E deep green, warm brass, bone white.
Details: Rule of thirds, austere in feeling, in the register of Roger Deakins night exteriors.
Text: Render exactly: "NORTHBOUND SUPPLY CO". Correct spelling, high contrast, no other text anywhere in frame.
Constraints: Do not include logos, watermarks, other people. No watermarks, no signatures, no borders.
notes: Adobe's own recommended order is image type, subject, action, angle, lighting, background, palette, style. Forge writes that order.
Firefly is the right default when the deliverable is for a client and Content Credentials are part of the deliverable.
warnings: 9:16 is not available on Image 5. If you need vertical social you must fall back to Image 4 or 4 Ultra.
A prose style description that contradicts a chosen Effect preset produces mush. Pick one or the other.

variations.name: Colder, more documentary
variations.text: Swap the grade for desaturated earth tones, drop to available light only, and shoot it on a 35mm at f/2.8. Same subject, no styling.

variations.name: Tighter and more graphic
variations.text: Go to an extreme close-up on the single most telling detail. Hard directional light, deep shadow, generous negative space around it.

variations.name: Wider, with context
variations.text: Pull back to an establishing wide. Put the subject small in the frame and let the setting carry the story. Keep the same light and grade.
